```{r}
library(targets)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(lubridate)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
library(mapview)
source(here("R/functions.R"))
```

Load carcass placements and feeding bouts
```{r}
# Classified feeding bouts
# XXX this part can be replaced with tar_load(feeding_bouts_station) when I have the pipeline updated.
tar_load(feeding_bouts_certain)
feeding_bouts_station <- purrr::map(feeding_bouts_certain, ~assign_fs(.x, fs_union))

# combine all individuals into one
bouts <- purrr::list_rbind(feeding_bouts_station) %>%
  st_as_sf(crs = "WGS84") %>%
  st_transform(32636)
      
length(unique(bouts$device_id)) # only 3 individuals represented right now, but we'll have more later.

# Load known carcass placements
tar_load(fs)
```

Restrict to carcass placements during the time of year
```{r}
max(fs$datetime) # we only have placements through 4/16/24 because of when I requested the data from Gideon. # XXX Write to Gideon and ask for the more up to date data.
# In the meantime, I'll analyze any that occurred during this interval

mindate <- min(bouts$start)
maxdate <- max(bouts$end)

fs_focal <- fs %>% filter(datetime >= mindate, datetime <= maxdate) # we have 11 feeding occurrences.

# Let's see if these individuals fed at these carcasses at all. If not, then I'll need more data for either individuals or carcasses.
```

For each carcass, let's look at feeding bouts within 1000m and 1 day of the carcass.
```{r}
carcass_bouts <- map(1:nrow(fs_focal), ~{
  carcass <- fs_focal[.x,]
  distances <- as.numeric(st_distance(bouts, carcass))
  bouts <- bouts %>%
    mutate(dist_to_carcass = distances)
  keep_distance <- bouts %>%
    filter(dist_to_carcass <= 1000)
  keep_time <- keep_distance %>%
    filter(start >= (carcass$datetime - hours(1)), # allow 1 hour before carcass
           end <= (carcass$datetime + hours(24))) %>% # allow 24 hours after carcass
    mutate(time_since_carcass = difftime(start, carcass$datetime))
  return(keep_time)
}) # only one of these carcasses has a couple feeding bouts. We can look at this for now.
```

```{r}
map_dbl(carcass_bouts, nrow)

cbtest <- carcass_bouts[[10]]

# Now let's see how the location of those feeding bouts corresponds to the location of the carcass as recorded by the INPA.
nrow(fs_focal)
carc <- fs_focal[10,]

toplot <- bind_rows(carc %>%
                      mutate(type = "carcass"),
                    cbtest %>%
                      mutate(type = "feeding_bout"))
ggplot(toplot)+
  geom_sf(aes(shape = type, col = dist_to_carcass),
          size = 5)+
  scale_color_viridis(name = "Distance\nto carcass", limits = c(0, 100))+
  scale_shape_manual(name = "", values = c(4, 19))+
  theme_bw()
```
